about: One-frame event of esv::camp::ChestSystem: the camp chest assigned to a user changed. Created on a new event entity by bg3.exe+0x2BEAF80 (AllocRaw 0x10) from bg3.exe+0x2BE9510 (macOS: esv::camp::ChestSystem::Update writes it), which writes the user id and the chest entity. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (server row).

evidence.says: Creator bg3.exe+0x2BEAF80 writes the global at bg3.exe+0x617CEAC (the default UserID global) at +0; writer bg3.exe+0x2BE9510 line ~900 copies a 4-byte user id to +0.
Creator writes 0xffc0000000000000 (null EntityHandle) at +8; writer line ~901 writes an 8-byte value at +8 (the entity assigned to the user; name from the component name).

survey.live_reason: no live or captured instance: needs a situation that creates it
open_questions: That +8 is the chest (and not the user's character) follows from the component name only.
Not seen alive (seen.py has no samples).
